executionStatus.engineTests: NOT EXECUTED — no calculateLoad engine exists; no case has passed or failed
executionStatus.schemaValidation: EXECUTED with mini_jsonschema_r2.py (declared draft-2020-12 SUBSET; self-tested; the reviewer re-validates with python-jsonschema)
executionStatus.invariantChecks: EXECUTED with contract_invariants_r22.py on every non-null expected result, bound to its RequestEnvelope (r2.1 checks unchanged + I-21 operative graph completeness: exact line set, ordered operand references with multiplicity, conductor association, governing = max terminal, complete comparison set; + unityPF requirement for L-L terms on the split-phase amperes path)

kinds.e2e_normative: envelope -> full result under profile A, or pending/future
kinds.future_ui_persistence: sequence specs for a future implementation; never marked passed

statusVocabulary.CONDITIONAL: expected null until blockingSources close or owner decision
statusVocabulary.PENDING_INTERPRETATION: expected null; needs an official interpretation

policy: CONDITIONAL / PENDING_INTERPRETATION / future* cases must never be recorded PASS. COMPLETE means demand-complete, never adequate. Verdicts compare RAW numbers (policy raw_conservative, <=); display strings never feed comparisons. Status precedence: EMPTY > UNSUPPORTED_SCOPE > BLOCKED_PENDING_RULE > INVALID_INPUT > INCOMPLETE_INPUT > UNQUALIFIED_METHOD > PARTIAL > COMPLETE; only layer=input problems drive rows 2-6, layer=demand unresolved coverage drives PARTIAL; all problems are always listed.
